purpose: Determine whether V72 can be tested without reusing the V71 development selection, identify a statistically fair replacement for the sample-size-biased global-maximum check, and nominate one mechanism that directly preserves V70 within-field structure while restoring the V63 marginal.

metadata_access.historical_scan: Read only source_index arrays from already disclosed ensemble*.h5 files below evaluation/**/development_candidate.
metadata_access.validation_scan: Read only file attributes, dataset names/shapes, TNG center_position_mpc_h, and CAMELS realization identifiers.

historical_development_consumption.finding: Every historical development ensemble reused the same sixteen indices in each domain; no other validation index has appeared in a development_candidate ensemble.

available_target_unseen_objects.simulation_realization_independence_cave: Indices are target-unseen, but multiple observers/cubes share the same parent simulation. SIMBA and Swift partitions are stratified by realization; TNG100 has only one parent box and is stratified spatially. Claims must be target-unseen confirmatory, not independent-simulation replication.

target_free_selection_algorithm.TNG100_groups: four (x<37.5 or x>=37.5, z<37.5 or z>=37.5) spatial groups from center_position_mpc_h; screen and confirmatory allocations are respectively 2,6,5,3
target_free_selection_algorithm.SIMBA_groups: realizations 24,25,26 with screen and confirmatory allocations respectively 3,5,8
target_free_selection_algorithm.Swift_groups: realizations 20-26 with screen and confirmatory allocations respectively 3,2,1,3,1,3,3

fresh_stage_A_screen.role: single-use model screen; its outcome may not change the frozen V72 candidate

fresh_stage_B_confirmatory.role: single-use target-unseen confirmation opened only after an exact stage-A pass

V71_failure_reinterpretation_for_new_des.small_scale_morphology: remaining 0-1 Mpc/h two-point and rho>10 peak-count failures
V71_failure_reinterpretation_for_new_des.mechanism_inference: Member-axis ECC preserved a voxelwise ensemble copula but injected paired independent marginal values independently across spatial voxels, leaving too much 6-10 h/Mpc power. A successor should preserve the within-member spatial rank field rather than only the across-member rank at each voxel.

global_maximum_gate_validity.old_measurement: one maximum pooled over 16 truth cubes versus one maximum pooled over 16 queries times 16 generated members, or 256 generated cubes
global_maximum_gate_validity.null_behavior: Even for identical continuous cube-maximum distributions, the expected maximum of 256 draws exceeds the expected maximum of 16 draws; the old check therefore has a built-in rejection bias.
V71_other_failures: field morphology checks in all domains
global_maximum_gate_validity.V72_requirement: Do not use the unequal-sample pooled maximum. Retain q99.999 and Q4, and compare per-query cube-maximum ensemble distributions with a proper score against the paired independent marginal control.

recommended_V72_candidate.name: conditioning-stratified spatial quantile transport
recommended_V72_candidate.construction: For each query and member, form target-free equal-occupancy strata from the frozen backbone-plus-target-mean field. Within each stratum, rank V70 raw latent voxels spatially, sort the paired independent standard-normal innovations over the same voxels, and assign those values by the V70 spatial rank.
recommended_V72_candidate.marginal_property: The candidate and paired control latent multisets are exactly equal within each query, member, and conditioning stratum before inverse transformation.
recommended_V72_candidate.joint_structure_property: Within every stratum and member, the complete V70 spatial rank order is retained; this is stronger for filaments and high-k coherence than V71 member-axis ECC.
recommended_V72_candidate.reason_preferred_before_a_new_large_fit: V70 raw samples already passed the train-only spectral and phase-sensitive gate. V71 failed after replacing spatial marginal values via member-axis ECC. SQT changes that identified coupling mechanism without selecting an A(k), clipping density, or fitting to V71 metrics.

freeze_before_implementation_or_stage_A_: the exact number and definition of target-free conditioning strata
V70 checkpoint, sampler, seed, and member count
fair tail proper score and every spectral/field threshold
required_next_program.stage_A_failure: seal and stop without stage-B access or candidate changes
required_next_program.stage_A_pass: run stage B exactly once without changing the candidate
required_next_program.stage_B_pass: seal and await explicit user approval before independent EAGLE
required_next_program.stage_B_failure: seal and stop before independent EAGLE
